items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers listed as doubtful for Sunday vs Saints after missing practices with hamstring.
items.implication: High chance OUT; fade Flowers, monitor hierarchy.
items.opportunity: Bateman/Walker/others elevated routes/targets; Andrews target share boost.

items.text: Raiders listing TE Brock Bowers doubtful for Sunday vs Chargers due to knee, per HC.
items.why: Knee injury; returned to practice Friday but doubtful tag.
items.implication: Likely limited/out; Mayer becomes startable TE.

items.text: Chargers listing WR Ladd McConkey questionable for Sunday vs Raiders (ribs); practiced Friday after missing prior.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; returned to practice Friday.
items.opportunity: Quentin Johnston primary beneficiary in routes/targets.

items.text: Bengals listing QB Joe Burrow questionable for Sunday at Houston (back); Burrow said he would play.
items.implication: Monitor; expected to play per comments, but risk to CIN pass game.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson ready to go; unclear how much he earns vs Rhamondre Stevenson, but timing perfect with AJ Brown on IR and strong upcoming matchups (PIT/JAX/BUF etc before bye).
items.why: Henderson: “I’m ready to go.” Pats desperate for explosives.
items.implication: Henderson stash/start upside in committee; monitor split.
items.opportunity: Explosive plays, carries/routes vs Stevenson; schedule boost.

items.text: If Zay Flowers can't go (hamstring, missed practices), Ravens WRs: 1. Bateman 2. Devontez Walker 3. Wester 4. Sarratt 5. Moore. Ja'Kobi Lane on IR.
items.why: Flowers missed two practices; Lane IR.
items.implication: Bateman primary add/start if Flowers OUT.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE Week 2 vs IND: 24% target share (tied lead) in Chiefs debut, 74% snaps, high util; Indy soft vs run (Henry 163 yds/3 TDs). RB1 overall range of outcomes.
Ashton Jeanty LOVE @ LAC: Utilization Score 99 (tied Bijan lead) in Kubiak debut; high target share history, 25+ touches recent.

ETR Week 2 waivers injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre’ Harris; Ja’Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; AJ Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller. Also OL/DL mismatches, Thorman ranks live.
Important: “My Guy” narrative brewing in Baltimore (context Flowers/Lane absences pointing to Bateman/others).
items.implication: Monitor specific Ravens WR for breakout.

items.text: Berry LOVE: Bucky Irving (26% tgt, all RZ, out-routed Gainwell vs CLE); DeVonta Smith (bounceback, 27% tgt/deep looks @ TEN); Justin Jefferson (37% tgt Wentz, strong vs CHI); Mike Evans (vs soft MIA); Dalton Kincaid (69% routes career-high-ish vs DET); Dak Prescott (home smash vs WAS).

Berry HATE: Travis Etienne (@BAL, committee/Kamara return, pass-heavy pts); Marvin Harrison Jr. (8% tgt vs SEA tough); Brian Thomas Jr. (@DEN tough perimeter/deep, shoulder); Harold Fannin (low 14% tgt/share, competition, low total @TB).
Nico Collins hamstring (history of multi-game absences); W1 routes 37/42 on Stroud dropbacks. MRI key.
items.why: Hammy in practice; prior 5-game miss in 2024. High route share.
items.implication: OUT confirmed later; deep WRs/Schultz rise.
